findings.title: Absent from every top-10 result for best managed IT Indianapolis
findings.evidence: VAF appears in 0 of 10 results while leapmanagedit.com is #2, bradenonline.com #6 and two directories (cloudtango.net #1, clutch.co #9) that list Leap but not VAF.
findings.impact: The 1,000/mo core term plus the AI-answer lists that cite these results all route to competitors.
findings.action: Claim cloudtango.net and clutch.co profiles, point the new /indianapolis/ IT page at the term, and earn 10 local links in 90 days.

findings.title: Largest-provider claim is not visible where the question is asked
findings.evidence: For 'who is the largest office technology provider in indiana' VAF is absent from 10 results although its home page states the claim; bradenonline.com ranks #4.
findings.impact: AI assistants answer the entity question with Braden or directory lists, eroding VAF's strongest positioning line.
findings.action: Publish a facts page (founded 1914, offices, headcount, brands) with Organization schema and get the claim cited on TechPoint, IBJ and Wikipedia-grade sources.

findings.title: Brand reviews SERP is owned by employer ratings, not customers
findings.evidence: Indeed 2.8 (73 reviews) and Glassdoor 3.3 (104) fill 8 of 10 results; Facebook shows 0 reviews, Yelp 2, and no Google Business Profile or BBB result appears.
findings.impact: Prospects checking 'Van Ausdall & Farrar reviews' see low employer scores and no customer proof.
findings.action: Launch a post-ticket Google review request flow, add a customer-reviews page with Review schema, and claim the BBB profile.

findings.title: City pages are the traffic engine competitors use and VAF lacks
findings.evidence: Leap's four /it-support-{city}/ pages earn 531 of 1,555 visits (34 percent); Taylored links 11 /location-{city}/ pages from its nav.
findings.impact: Carmel, Fishers, Noblesville, Greenwood and Muncie searches, including 'managed service provider carmel indiana' (720/mo, KD 13), go elsewhere.
findings.action: Build 6 suburb pages on the existing Indianapolis template with LocalBusiness schema and unique service proof per city.

findings.title: Referring domains are job boards and data scrapers, not industry
findings.evidence: Of VAF's 15 strongest referring domains, 9 are employment or people-data sites (indeed, payscale, levels.fyi, rocketreach, leadiq); ringcentral.com (66) is the only vendor link.
findings.impact: Authority Score stays at 21 against 27 (AME, Taylored), 24 (Leap) and 23 (Braden) with 1,377 and 1,147 referring domains respectively.
findings.action: Secure partner-directory links from Canon, Ricoh, Kyocera, Mitel, 8x8 and Fortinet plus chamber and TechPoint listings in the 90-day plan.

findings.title: Home page still lacks city in title and any FAQ
findings.evidence: Title is 48 characters without Indianapolis, 0 FAQ, og:image is the stock artificial-intelligence.jpg; the H1 sits outside the main element.
findings.impact: The page carrying 85 percent of traffic underperforms on the local modifier and answer-engine extraction.
findings.action: Retitle to 'Indianapolis Managed IT, Copiers & Phones | Van Ausdall & Farrar', add a 6-question FAQ with FAQPage schema and a branded og:image.

findings.title: Copier lease visibility comes from the wrong page
findings.evidence: VAF's only result for 'copier lease indianapolis' is /copy-print-solutions/ at #10, not /copiers/, while 'copier leasing' (880, KD 22) and 'office equipment rental' (1,900, KD 3) are open.
findings.impact: Two pages split the copier topic and leapcopierprinter.com holds #9 with a single focused page.
findings.action: Make /copiers/ the lease hub with a leasing FAQ, rental section and canonical links from copy-print-solutions.

findings.title: Question keywords have no home on the site
findings.evidence: 'what is managed it services' (1,000), 'how much does managed it services cost' (720), 'what is managed print services' (320) and 'how much does it cost to lease a copy machine' (260) exist; only 2 of 10 audited pages carry FAQPage schema.
findings.impact: AI Overviews and chat answers pull these definitions from Taylored's blog (its managed IT vs in-house post earns 290 visits).
findings.action: Add FAQ blocks to all 8 service pages and publish 4 cost and definition guides in the 90-day content sprint.

findings.title: Phone systems page is thin for a 9,900/mo head term
findings.evidence: 550 words, 3 H2s, no FAQ, and copy still references ShoreTel; yet the page is #4 in results for 'business phone systems indianapolis'.
findings.impact: VAF sits at position 25 for 'business phone systems' (9,900, KD 44) where no local competitor ranks top 100.
findings.action: Expand to 1,200 words with VoIP, UCaaS and contact-center sections, a pricing-factors FAQ and RingCentral, Mitel and 8x8 comparison.

findings.title: Managed print page ranks #6 but cannot hold the national term
findings.evidence: 574 words, 3 H2s, no FAQ; opportunity terms 'managed print services near me' (720, KD 7) and 'managed print services companies' (720, KD 12).
findings.impact: A KD 16 term with 4,400 monthly searches stays unranked while the page already has Service schema and local visibility.
findings.action: Add an MPS assessment calculator, an 8-question FAQ and near-me copy for all three offices.

findings.title: Document conversion page misses the scanning vocabulary
findings.evidence: 'document scanning services near me' (1,900, KD 19) and 'document scanning company' (880, KD 20) do not appear in the 55-character title or H1.
findings.impact: 765 words of good content target 'conversion', a phrase searchers rarely use.
findings.action: Retitle to 'Document Scanning Services Indianapolis' and add a bulk scanning section.

findings.title: AI and healthcare pages drop the city and carry a typo
findings.evidence: /ai title (48 chars) and /industries/healthcare-technology-solutions title (54) omit Indianapolis; the healthcare meta reads 'Healthcare Indust'.
findings.impact: Two high-intent vertical pages miss the local modifier that all other service pages carry.
findings.action: Fix the meta and add Indianapolis to both titles in the build.

findings.title: Robots and sitemap are healthy; keep AI crawlers open
findings.evidence: robots.txt allows all agents except /ecampaign/ and declares sitemap.xml; GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot and Google-Extended are not blocked.
findings.impact: No crawl barrier to AI visibility, so the gap is content and authority, not access.
findings.action: Keep the policy, add an llms.txt and clean the 324 query-string blog URLs from the sitemap.

why_beaten.intro: The same three money pages, side by side. Assistants and Google pick the entity with the most corroborating evidence. Today that is Leap for managed IT and Taylored for depth.

absent, despite the claim on the home page
why_beaten.verdict: VAF tells engines who it is. Competitors tell engines why to pick them: ratings, more words per service, and a page for every suburb. The two VAF pages that carry FAQPage schema are the two that rank, so the pattern works. It has been applied to two pages out of ten.

leverage.intro: The five moves with the biggest return for the least effort, in the order we would do them. Each one is either in the build or in the first 30 days of the plan.

items.move: FAQPage plus Service schema on all twelve service pages
items.payoff: The two pages that have it are the only VAF pages ranking for non-branded terms (number 4 phones, number 6 managed print). Extending it to managed IT, cybersecurity and document services puts VAF in the answer set for 'what is managed IT services' (1,000 a month) and 'how much does managed IT cost' (720).

items.move: A Google review program and Review schema on the pages
items.payoff: 'Best managed IT Indianapolis' returns ten results and VAF is not one. Both competitors carry AggregateRating. Ratings are the signal that gets a company into the 'best' list. Today the brand reviews query returns Indeed and Glassdoor employer ratings in 8 of 10 spots.

items.move: Four suburb pages: Carmel, Fishers, Noblesville, Greenwood
items.payoff: Leap earns 34 percent of its traffic from four city pages. 'Managed service provider Carmel Indiana' is 720 searches a month at difficulty 13. The location page template in the build already carries LocalBusiness schema.

items.move: An entity facts page that states the largest-provider claim with evidence
items.payoff: Assistants answer 'who is the largest office technology provider in Indiana' with Braden and directories. The claim is on VAF's home page but nowhere an engine can cite: founding year, headquarters size, four pillars, three offices, partner list, NPS and SOC 2 on one page with Organization schema.

items.move: Swap job-board backlinks for vendor and chamber links
items.payoff: Authority Score 21 against 24 and 27 is level, but 9 of the top 15 referring domains are job boards. Partner directories (Canon, Ricoh, Kyocera, Mitel, Fortinet), Indy Chamber, the Indiana Business Journal and BBB are the links competitors have and VAF does not.
